section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study by Moreira et al. (2018) that adapted the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for Brazilian young adolescents. The text reviews previous BAS validation studies conducted in Brazil with different populations (men, older adults, men with spinal cord injuries) and notes that none of these prior studies evaluated body appreciation in adolescent samples. The present study aims to fill this gap by adapting the BAS to the Brazilian adolescent population and examining its psychometric properties.
